description: Source code for map sensor decoding and processing in engine control firmware, including pressure sensor calibration, validation, and data acquisition functions.

methods.name: decodePressure
methods.description: Decodes voltage to pressure in kPa based on sensor configuration.

methods.name: validateMap
methods.description: Checks if MAP sensor value is within expected range.

methods.name: validateBaroMap
methods.description: Validates barometric MAP sensor value against expected atmospheric range.

methods.name: getMapByVoltage
methods.description: Returns manifold absolute pressure in kPa from voltage input.

methods.name: getRawMap
methods.description: Retrieves raw MAP value, either from sensor or frequency-based estimate.

methods.name: hasBaroSensor
methods.description: Determines if a barometric sensor is present or fixed MAP is used.

methods.name: hasMapSensor
methods.description: Checks if MAP sensor hardware channel is configured.

methods.name: getBaroPressure
methods.description: Returns barometric pressure, possibly overridden by fixed MAP value.

methods.name: initMapDecoder
methods.description: Initializes MAP sensor decoder and configuration, including fixed MAP setup.
